children: CFO Colette Kress is reportedly being considered as interim CEO as the board weighs removing current CEO Jensen Huang.
The full board has yet to decide, but the company’s directors are scheduled to meet Wednesday evening, Semafor reported.
The Nvidia board briefed the White House on its planned meeting, according to a senior administration official, the report said.
The development follows reports that Nvidia’s
board of directors is preparing to remove CEO and founder Jensen Huang amid allegations of an improper relationship with a company executive.
The chip giant’s stock fell more than 8% in after-hours trading, hitting a 52-week low.

title: Nvidia board weighs CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO amid Jensen Huang scrutiny: Semafor
